dedupe_keys.name: comunidad foral de navarra cycling and walking datasets

description: Comunidad Foral de Navarra: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Foral de Navarra. Coverage: Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Movilidad ciclista. Aparcamientos para bicicletas; Movilidad ciclista. Servicios accesibles a usuarios de bicicletas; Movilidad ciclista. Señalización vertical ciclista; SIG de Movilidad Ciclista (SIGMC) de Navarra. Formats seen: SHP, GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
